items.raw_excerpt: 28-year-old Valerio Tuveri became known on social media as "the guy who cleans Rome" after he began posting videos of himself cleaning graffiti from the Italian capital's walls.
items.summary_en: 28-year-old Valerio Tuveri became known on social media as 'the guy who cleans Rome'. He posts videos of himself cleaning graffiti from the Italian capital's walls.
items.summary_ko: 28세 발레리오 투베리는 로마 벽에서 낙서를 지우는 영상을 올리며 '로마 청소부'로 알려졌습니다. 그는 소셜 미디어에 영상을 올려 주목받고 있습니다.
